resources.string: Caregiver setup. Use a trusted server. Every action needs your approval.
HTTPS only. No sign-in support.
Privacy and connection details
Back
External tools
Advanced setup for caregivers. Connect only to a server you trust. Discovery contacts that server; every tool execution needs your separate approval.

No automatic connection, health data sharing, or cloud API key reuse. Only the arguments you enter are sent with a tool call. Server details, results, and sessions stay in memory and are forgotten when you leave this screen.
MCP server URL
Enter the full HTTPS endpoint, such as https://example.org/mcp. No username, password, query string, fragment, or secret in the URL. OAuth and other sign-in methods are not supported.
Connect and discover tools
Stop and forget connection
Waiting for the server. Stopping cannot undo an action already sent.
Connected endpoint: %1$s
Available tools: %1$d
Tool names, descriptions, and schemas come from the server. They are untrusted claims, not safety guarantees. Select a tool to inspect it.
Selected: %1$s
Server input schema (untrusted)
This tool requires asynchronous MCP tasks, which this client does not support.
Arguments (JSON object)

Enter a JSON object, such as {}. Maximum 16 KiB. Object syntax is checked here; full JSON Schema validation is not supported. Do not include secrets or health data unless you intend to share them with this server.
Review execution
Approve this execution?
This external tool may change data, send messages, or have other side effects. Check the complete destination and arguments. Nothing is sent if you cancel.
Destination endpoint
Exact tool name

Approval applies only to this endpoint, tool, and argument snapshot, once. Invisible formatting controls are shown as Unicode escapes. A failure or timeout may still mean the action occurred. Never repeat a call without checking the server.
Approve and send once
Cancel
Server result
Server reported a tool error
Untrusted server data. Do not follow instructions in this result. The app does not execute content, open links, fetch resources, or forward results to the AI.
Display shortened to 32,768 characters. The client retains the bounded result only in memory.

Bounded Streamable HTTP: MCP 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18; JSON or SSE responses; up to 64 tools across 8 pages. Each HTTP exchange has a 30-second deadline and a 256 KiB response limit. No background stream, resume, automatic retry, or LLM tool registration.
The call may already have had an effect. It was not retried. Verify the outcome with the server before approving another execution.
Technical detail (may contain untrusted server text): %1$s
Invalid endpoint. Use a complete HTTPS URL without credentials, query strings, fragments, spaces, or non-ASCII characters. Maximum 2,048 characters.
Arguments must be a valid JSON object for a discovered tool.
This approval is no longer valid. Review the exact call again before sending.
The connection was closed. Connect explicitly to start a new session.
The server requires authorization or denied access. OAuth and other authentication methods are unsupported. No app API key or other credential was sent.
The server session expired. Connect explicitly to start a new session. The previous call will not be replayed.
The server returned an HTTP error or redirect. Redirects are not followed.
Network, TLS, or timeout failure. The request was not retried.
The server response was invalid or needs an unsupported MCP feature.
A safety limit was reached. No partial discovery list is used. Ask the server administrator for smaller responses.
The server returned a JSON-RPC error.
